# Darwin Geospatial

> Darwin Geospatial builds geospatial, Earth observation, software, and applied AI solutions — turning satellite, environmental, and sensor data into practical tools for analysis and decision-making. The Darwin Agent Center is a read-only, vendor-neutral HTTP API exposing company information, project portfolio, and integration capabilities to any compatible AI system or application.

## API

- [Company profile](https://admin-darwin-agent-center-721070867001.europe-west1.run.app/api/v1/company): Public company overview.
- [Project portfolio](https://admin-darwin-agent-center-721070867001.europe-west1.run.app/api/v1/portfolio): Public catalog of Darwin's projects, with area/application/market classification.
- [Onboarding guide](https://admin-darwin-agent-center-721070867001.europe-west1.run.app/api/v1/onboarding): Public new-hire onboarding content.

## Machine-readable spec

- [OpenAPI spec](https://darwingeospatial.com/openapi.json): full request/response schemas for the endpoints above.

## Notes

- Every endpoint above is read-only.
